summary:

searchability: 'Unshaken' is a common dictionary word (Merriam-Webster), easy to say and spell, and it fits the stoic, discipline and black-gold tone. As a TikTok CTA ('Put lines like this on your lock screen -> Unshaken, link in bio') it sounds strong. Viewers may type 'unshakable' or 'unshakeable' instead; the App Store exact match 'Unshakeable' is an unrelated Education app, and 'Mantle: Become Unshakeable' is a Health & Fitness app. App Store: the 'unshaken' query returns only 4 apps, so a new app would rank high, but always next to Unshaken Stoic, which has the same concept. TikTok: the namespace is crowded and splits users. The bare @unshaken is dormant (2 followers). @unshaken.daily (370 followers) and @unshakendaily (a Stoic 'Unshaken') are in the same niche. @unshakenapp is a quit-porn brand. Our handle needs a suffix. Google: generic 'unshaken' results are dominated by the dictionary, Christian books and devotionals, lululemon's Unshaken pants, and Become Unshaken. The brand would need to compete on 'unshaken app' or 'unshaken discipline' rather than the bare word.
risks: Live USPTO registration BECOME UNSHAKEN (Reg. 8430831, registered 2026-09-15) owned by Unshaken, LLC. It covers Class 9 downloadable personal-growth and motivation content plus Class 41/45 personal-growth services. The owner has an IP attorney and other pending UNSHAKEN marks, and can refile its abandoned UNSHAKEN word mark. Real risk of a demand letter, an opposition to our own filing, or an Apple IP dispute after launch.

A direct competitor already uses 'Unshaken' for the identical concept: Unshaken Stoic on iOS since 2026-05-08, plus 'Unshaken: Daily Stoic Quotes' on Android with 500+ downloads. Both offer daily Stoic quotes, a widget and notifications. Prior-user common-law rights, plus user confusion in App Store search.

Several others are building 'Unshaken' Stoic, discipline or confidence brands: unshakendaily.com ('Launching Soon') with @unshakendaily; @unshaken.daily (146 videos); tryunshaken.com ($27 confidence course); unshakenhq.com registered 10 days ago. More collisions are likely by launch in late 2026.

Association with a quit-porn brand: @unshakenapp TikTok, the lapsed unshaken.app, and the removed 'UNSHAKEN: Quit Porn Now' App Store app. Possible App Store Connect name reservation, and a handle one character away from our likely @unshaken.app.
lululemon owns UNSHAKEN for clothing (Reg. 8311366) and sells a men's 'Unshaken' line to the same demographic. It blocks any branded merch and dominates Google and shopping results.
unshaken.com costs $48,990 on Afternic, so the brand will live on a prefixed domain. unshaken.app may drop, but that is not guaranteed.
The bare TikTok @unshaken is held by a dormant 2019 account and cannot be claimed. Many in-niche @unshaken* accounts dilute TikTok search.
Strong Christian and faith connotation online (books, hymn app, apparel, phone cases, worship songs). That may blur positioning for a secular discipline and money app aimed at young men.

Caveats on the evidence: TikTok 'no_account_found' does not guarantee a handle can be claimed (it may be banned or reserved). RDAP 'unregistered' can still be premium-priced or reserved. App Store name availability is only confirmed by creating the app record in App Store Connect, because unreleased or removed apps can hold names the Search API cannot see. The USPTO checks covered the federal register only; state registrations and common-law use need a full clearance search by a trademark attorney.
summary: Unshaken sounds right for this app and is pronounceable on TikTok, but it is already taken in the exact niche. An app called 'Unshaken' (Unshaken Stoic, iOS since May 2026, Android 500+ downloads) already ships the same product: a daily public-domain Stoic quote with a home-screen widget and daily notification. Unshaken, LLC holds a live USPTO registration for BECOME UNSHAKEN (Reg. 8430831, 2026-09-15) covering Class 9 downloadable personal-growth and motivation content, with an attorney and more UNSHAKEN filings pending. lululemon owns UNSHAKEN for apparel (Reg. 8311366) and sells a men's Unshaken line. A quit-porn brand called UNSHAKEN holds @unshakenapp and the now-lapsing unshaken.app, and several in-niche TikTok accounts and 'launching soon' sites use the word. The best available combination is App Store 'Unshaken: Daily Discipline' (no live app with that name), TikTok @unshaken.app (or @useunshaken), and getunshaken.com or getunshaken.app (unregistered). unshaken.com costs $48,990. Given the trademark exposure and the direct same-concept competitor, viability for this app is low: 3/10. I would recommend a different name unless a trademark attorney clears it, and even then the brand would always be confused with Unshaken Stoic.

(a $3B+ contract-software company that literally owns ironcladapp.com and ranks for 'ironclad app'), Ironclad gloves, the Slay the Spire 2 Ironclad character, Civil War ironclad warships, and several gyms. On the App Store, 'ironclad' already returns 21 results including a live exact-name app (Grata) and other Ironclad apps in Health & Fitness and Productivity, and the getironclad.app competitor is about to join them. On TikTok, the top 'Ironclad' motivation result is the existing @ironcladdaily account (8.3K followers, 945 videos), so users who search for us will land on it. Pronunciation is the strong point: 'IRON-clad' is two syllables, unambiguous to spell after hearing it, sounds strong and masculine, and suits a black-and-gold look. '...put this on your lock screen -> Ironclad, link in bio' reads well. The brand is just very hard to own in search.
risks: A direct same-name competitor is launching now. 'Ironclad - You vs your potential' (getironclad.app) is a discipline/self-improvement app for the same audience. Its domain was registered 2026-09-27, its ToS are dated 2026-10-04, and its store links are placeholders. It will probably launch first, likely holds an App Store Connect name reservation, and would have the senior claim to 'Ironclad' for self-improvement apps.

TikTok confusion: @ironcladdaily is an established motivation account (8,265 followers, 945 videos, 103.7K likes, since Feb 2024) in our exact niche. @ironclad itself is a dormant 2015 account with 0 videos, so it is effectively unobtainable.

The bare App Store name 'Ironclad' is taken by a live app (Grata Technologies, Lifestyle, released 2026-04-29), so we must use a suffixed name. Suffixed names like 'Ironclad: Daily Discipline' show no live match, but reservations by unreleased apps are invisible to the Search API. Only creating the record in App Store Connect proves availability.

Trademark: Ironclad, Inc. holds IRONCLAD marks for downloadable and online software (class 9/42). A US filing for IRONCLAD in class 9 would likely meet a 2(d) refusal or opposition, so we probably could not register the brand. The name is also widely used by others (gyms, apparel, mindset sites), which weakens distinctiveness and enforcement.

Tom Bilyeu/Impact Theory has used 'Ironclad Discipline' (workshop; owns ironcladdiscipline.com). Naming the app 'Ironclad: Daily Discipline' invites association with a much bigger creator in the same audience.

Domain gaps: ironclad.com belongs to the gloves brand, ironcladapp.com and ironcladhq.com belong to Ironclad, Inc., ironclad.app is Sedo-parked at an unknown price, and getironclad.app belongs to the competitor. Only longer variants (ironcladlines.com, ironcladwidget.com, ironcladdaily.app) are unregistered, and RDAP 404 does not rule out premium or registry-reserved pricing.
Search noise from Ironclad, Inc., Ironclad gloves, the Slay the Spire 2 Ironclad character and warship history will make organic App Store, Google and TikTok discovery and brand monitoring hard.
Merch risk: Ironclad Performance Wear (gloves and apparel since 1996) and a February 2026 UK IRONCLAD gym-clothing application make branded gym apparel or gloves risky.

Probe caveats: TikTok 'no_account_found' (statusCode 10221) means only that there is no active public account; banned, deleted or reserved handles may still be unclaimable. iTunes Search calls were rate-limited (HTTP 403) and retried until they succeeded.
summary: 'Ironclad' sounds great for a black-and-gold men's discipline brand and works well in a TikTok CTA. Its availability and conflict picture is poor, though. The bare App Store name is already live (Grata Technologies' resident app, Lifestyle, April 2026). The biggest problem is a same-name app in our niche about to launch: 'Ironclad - You vs your potential' (getironclad.app, registered 2026-09-27, ToS dated 2026-10-04, store links still placeholders), a daily discipline/productivity scoring app that will probably launch first and likely already holds an App Store Connect reservation. On TikTok, @ironclad is a dormant 2015 account (0 videos), and @ironcladdaily is an active motivation brand with 8,265 followers and 945 videos aimed at our audience. Ironclad, Inc. (a CLM company valued at about $3.2B, owner of ironcladapp.com and ironcladhq.com, with IRONCLAD software marks) dominates search and would likely block a class 9 trademark. Tom Bilyeu owns ironcladdiscipline.com and has run an 'Ironclad Discipline' workshop. The best workable combination is 'Ironclad: Daily Discipline' (no live US match, ASC reservation unverified) + @ironclad.app (no account found) + ironcladlines.com (unregistered). Even so, we would be the second or third 'Ironclad' in self-improvement, with weak search ownership and no realistic path to a registered trademark. Viability: 3/10. I would not choose this name unless the getironclad.app project turns out to be abandoned.

searchability: Poor. \"Locked\" is a common English word, and an App Store search for it returns app lockers, photo vaults, escape-room games, NFC screen-time blockers, and more than 40 \"Locked In\" discipline apps. A new app would not rank for its own name without paid Apple Search Ads on the brand. On TikTok, searching \"locked\" or \"locked in\" brings up a large amount of 2025 \"Great Lock In\" slang content plus established accounts such as @lockd.app (13.5K followers). On Google, the 2025 film Locked, Locked On Podcast Network, and lock or security companies dominate. The word is easy to say and fits the aesthetic (\"Put lines like this on your lock screen -> Locked\"). The catch is that spoken aloud it is identical to LOCKD (a discipline app with 106 ratings) and Lockd (a lock screen wallpaper app with 4K ratings), and close to LOKD. Anyone who hears the voiceover and searches instead of tapping the bio link will often land on a competitor. The lock screen pun is clever but fragile: the widget surface is also the main way Lockd is discovered.
risks: An identical-name app in the same niche, LOCKED: Reach Your Potential, had about 2.1K ratings and an active TikTok (@locked_app, 86 videos). It is currently pulled, but it has prior common-law use, probably still holds its App Store Connect name, and could return or send a cease-and-desist.

At least two other "Locked" discipline or productivity apps are pre-launch right now: the joinlocked.app LOCKED social network (waitlist, registered 2026-09-16) and the @getlockedapp / lockedapp.app "Doomscroll productively" project (2026-08-16). Domain registrations for joinlocked.com, getlockedapp.com and lockedlines.com in Aug-Sep 2026 point to a crowded naming race before a late-2026 launch.

Sound-alike confusion with LOCKD: Life Reset & Lock in (a live discipline app, 4.85 from 106 ratings) and Lockd Lock Screen Wallpapers (4,013 ratings; 13.5K TikTok followers) undermines spoken TikTok CTAs.

Every requested TikTok handle (@locked, @lockedapp, @locked.app, @getlocked, @locked.daily, @lockeddaily, @thelocked, @lockedhq, @locked_app, @locked.co) is taken. The brand would have to live on a descriptor handle like @lockedwidget, and "no_account_found" does not guarantee the handle can be claimed (banned, deleted or reserved handles return the same).

No premium domain is attainable cheaply. locked.com has been held since 1997 by an operating company. locked.app is an aftermarket listing on Atom. lockedapp.com and trylocked.com are GoDaddy for-sale listings at unknown prices. The available domains are long-tail (lockedwidget.com, lockeddaily.com) and could still be premium or reserved despite the RDAP 404.

The trademark is weak and hard to enforce. LOCKED is a common, arguably descriptive word for a focus or discipline app. You can probably register it in Class 9, but stopping the many Locked, Lockd and Locked In apps would be difficult. Future Class 25 merch (gym and discipline apparel) would collide with several LOCKED IN apparel registrations.

App Store full-name uniqueness: the bare name "Locked" is taken by a 2009 game. Names like "Locked: Daily Discipline" are also close to the live "Locked In: Daily Discipline". Unreleased or removed apps may hold Locked-prefixed names that the Search API cannot see, so creating the App Store Connect record is the only definitive check.
The trend term will date. "Lock in" peaked as 2025 TikTok slang; by late 2026 it may read as dated or as one of many copycat apps.
summary: "Locked" sounds right for the brand but is a weak, crowded choice for this app (3/10). On the App Store, the bare name belongs to a 2009 padlock game. "LOCKED: Reach Your Potential" was a same-niche discipline app with about 2.1K ratings. It has since been pulled from the store, but its TikTok @locked_app is still up. The sound-alikes LOCKD (discipline app, 106 ratings) and Lockd (lock screen wallpapers, 4K ratings, 13.5K TikTok followers) share the exact pronunciation. On top of that, more than 42 "Locked In" discipline apps exist, including one with lock screen quote widgets. Two more "Locked" discipline or productivity apps are pre-launch right now: the joinlocked.app LOCKED social network and the @getlockedapp / lockedapp.app project. All 10 requested TikTok handles are taken, including @lockeddaily, a two-month-old discipline-quotes account. All key domains are taken or on resale. On the plus side, USPTO shows no live LOCKED mark in Classes 9, 41 or 42 (the only live LOCKED mark is Class 12 car shocks), so the legal risk is moderate rather than blocking. The best realistic combo is "Locked: Discipline Widget" on the App Store, @lockedwidget on TikTok, and lockedwidget.com. All three are unclaimed as far as these checks can tell, subject to App Store Connect name reservation and possible TikTok or premium-domain holds. Even so, the name would be hard to find in search and could get mixed up with LOCKD or Lockd in spoken TikTok CTAs. A more distinctive coined name is recommended.
